collection_policy: greedy_delivery: deterministic, state-only. If carrying a requested shelf -> BFS to nearest goal cell; if carrying a non-requested shelf -> BFS to nearest free storage slot then TOGGLE_LOAD; else BFS to nearest requested shelf then TOGGLE_LOAD. Rotation chosen by the shorter turn, ties -> LEFT. No RNG, no query outcome is consulted.
continuation_policy: rho = the same greedy_delivery collection policy
state_selection: every cadence-th step of every episode from burn_in onward; NO filtering by any query outcome; panel-construction failures are recorded, not dropped
